experiment: acceptance gate on the cw4 candidate (both shapes)
gate_result: RETEST (all 12 windows flagged contended by co-tenant presence; precision=pass, authenticity=pass)
why_raw_is_usable: the windows' own canary inflation is ~1.00-1.03 (no real interference) and the prefill vendor median 0.0554 ms is close to the clean 0.0514 ms, so the paired ratios are informative even though the gate would not certify them
protocol_note: classify_window voids a window on the mere PRESENCE of a co-tenant PID (consistent with an earlier design choice), but on this shared machine light/transient co-tenants are everywhere and perturb nothing (canary flat). This over-blocks certification; per the shared-machine policy (another tenant's use is not unavailability; only actual interference matters) it should void on OBSERVED interference (canary>=1.15 or aicore peak high), not on presence alone.
